output.summary: Cherry tree thought to have originated on the Iranian Plateau or in Eastern Europe, although truly wild populations may no longer exist. Its acidic fruit has edible sour pulp, with dark-red Morello and lighter-red Amarelle as its two main cultivar groups.
output.edibilityNote: The sour fruit pulp is edible; dried cherries are cooked in savoury dishes and desserts or made into fruit spreads.
